fields.why: Table 1 tests each level of education (4 groups), race/ethnicity (4) and maternal age (3) by t-test against a Ref level (§§ marks), so groupwise-looking results exist.
Education (SES, 4 levels), race/ethnicity (4) and age (3) each compare 3+ groups; insurance drops to 2 compared groups after the no-insurance suppression, and region is geography, not an SPD.
Methods state t-tests and Table 1 marks only differences 'compared with Ref'; no omnibus or trend test is reported.
